model: Full-rank grouped PCA rotation forest with nonlinear randomized trees
distinct_from_completed_routes: Previous axis-aligned ExtraTrees and quantile forests did not train member-specific orthogonal chemically oblique splits. This method learns distinct grouped PCA rotations only on fitting structures. No rejected models/predictions reused.
preprocessing: Full original fingerprints, descriptor/shape/pharmacophore/context. Fit-onlydf>=3,top1024fragmentcounts byprevalence plusallnonfragments. Fitmedian/mean/std,clip5,explicitmissingness,constantdrop.
rotations: Each member group8 random permutation,75%fitstructure subbag,full eigenbasis retained,signcanonicalized. Trees split rotated directions; no query labels or statistics.
limitations: Publiclabelsreused;upstreamhistoricalOOFapproximate;randomrotations can obscure rarefragment effects. No scoreguarantee.
